description: Recorded numerical results, calibration scores, evaluation counts, timing measurements and circuit resource counts.

formats.csv: UTF-8 with a header row; blank fields are missing or inapplicable values.
formats.npz: Compressed NumPy arrays; load with allow_pickle=False.

paths: File paths are relative to data/. Optional cache_path values are relative to the repository root and identify locations used by the existing experiment scripts.

metrics.error_rates: Probabilities in [0, 1]. Protocol-comparison results use the arithmetic mean of Z- and X-basis logical failure probabilities. Hybrid results use the Z-basis simulation.
metrics.acceptance: Fraction of attempted trials retained by the protocol or filter. target_accept specifies the requested fraction; achieved_accept and cal_accept specify measured fractions.
metrics.conditional_error: Logical failures divided by accepted trials, except where results are explicitly averaged over independent repetitions or bases.
metrics.shots: Number of simulated trials; see the Steane detection note for the initial-shot field.
metrics.timing: T_filter_ns and T_decode_ns are nanoseconds. t_round_us and t_round_us_mean are microseconds. seconds and sec_* fields are seconds.

datasets.description: Error correction with ED, EE-T and SE for Steane and surface codes.
EE-T and EE-NC error correction for Steane and surface codes.
SW and DS filtering with MWPM and NN decoding, and unfiltered decoding.
notes: The meta column contains JSON with shot counts and thresholds where recorded. accept is the measured acceptance fraction.
pure_mwpm_d3_plocal0.01.csv records the unfiltered MWPM results. Unfiltered NN results are included in the NN table.

datasets.description: Hybrid filtering and three-layer distillation at a common target acceptance.
notes: distill_logical_error is (distill_zz + distill_xx) / 2, with noiseless final readout.
In the hybrid tables, accept is the requested distillation acceptance; meta.accept_emp is the measured hybrid acceptance.
The hybrid tables also retain six records at p_trans = 0.01, outside the plotted range.

datasets.description: NN decoding over transmission error rates and target acceptance probabilities.
notes: The local error rate and target acceptance are encoded in each filename. accept is the measured acceptance.
The plot uses DS+<target> and unfiltered rows; the original tables also retain SW+<target> rows.
ler and accept are arithmetic means over two evaluation repetitions.

datasets.description: Error detection with repetition, Steane and surface codes.
notes: The distill_success_rate and distill_logical_error column names are shared by all three code caches.
distillation_basis_avg_cache.csv is the repetition-code baseline.
The surface and repetition per_basis tables retain the separate basis estimates and available counts. Steane basis results are in protocol_comparison/steane_per_basis.csv.
The Steane cache records Z-basis acceptance and the mean of the two basis error rates; the per-basis table preserves both acceptance estimates.

datasets.description: Finite-size results, raw calibration scores and evaluation counts for three filters.
notes: fig11_all_points.csv contains all results; threshold_scan_*.csv partitions those same rows by filter and target acceptance.
Each calibration array is shared by four targets. calibration.csv records full-precision thresholds; the result tables retain their original 10-significant-digit formatting.
Four target rows share each evaluation chunk. Count shots once per (estimator, d, p_trans, chunk).
Use only included_in_aggregate=True rows to reproduce the final results. Chunks after the sequential stopping point are retained with this field set to False.
Stop at the first prefix of at least four chunks where every target has at least 100 failures, or at 1,250 chunks. Five aggregate points reached the cap with fewer than 100 failures.
condL = failures / accepted; ci95_lo and ci95_hi are two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals.

datasets.description: Filter and decoder runtime measurements, thresholds and machine configuration.
notes: runtime_plotted_values.csv contains the 64 plotted bars. runtime_results_regen.csv contains summary statistics; runtime_reps_regen.csv retains individual repeated measurements.
For each repetition, t_round_us = T_filter_ns / rounds / 1000 + T_decode_ns / max(1, accepted) / 1000. The plotted values are the arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation of this quantity.
Each plotted repetition attempts 500 rounds. There are 20 repetitions per point, or five for NN on one CPU core.
The original tables also retain auxiliary batch1 measurements; single-repetition groups have no sample standard deviation.
thresholds_regen.csv records calibration counts and thresholds. environment_regen.csv records the hardware, software and timing-quality criteria.
valid preserves the original timing-quality flag. The plotted table retains the recorded values, including rows with valid=False.

datasets.description: Basis-specific source data shared by the protocol comparisons.
notes: surface_correction_per_basis.csv retains shot counts, failures, standard errors and seeds for both bases and four protocols.
surface_exact_plocal0.csv records exact enumeration with noise-free local operations.
steane_per_basis.csv uses exact maximum-likelihood decoding. kind=corr supplies Figures 4 and 5; kind=det supplies Figure 10.

For Steane correction, shots is the simulated count. For Steane detection, shots is the initial requested count; adaptive sampling can increase the actual number of trials, which this source table does not record.

datasets.description: Circuit resource counts for nine protocol and code combinations.
notes: single_qubit_gates includes measurement and reset operations.
local_noise_locations and transmission_noise_locations count applications of the corresponding noise channels.

datasets.description: X- and Z-basis comparisons for unfiltered MWPM, SW + MWPM and DS + MWPM.
notes: The d3 tables use p_local in {0.005, 0.01} and p_trans in {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25}; targets are the distillation acceptance probabilities.
d3_per_basis.csv retains sampled counts, thresholds, seeds and intervals. d3_exact.csv records exact probabilities; d3_comparison.csv pairs the two bases.

d5_d7_d9_comparison.csv uses p_local = 0.003 and p_trans in {0.08, 0.14, 0.20}; filtered targets are 0.1 and 0.8. The table records separate basis counts and comparisons at calibrated thresholds and matched acceptance.
These are independent basis-comparison runs supporting the simulation setup; the main hybrid curves are stored in their figure directories.

files.transformation: Keep the 28 surface-code rows; the Steane-code data are in protocol_comparison/steane_per_basis.csv.
Flatten the four acceptance thresholds from each of 84 calibration records. Retain scientific fields; omit process and host identifiers.

Flatten the four acceptance targets from each of 8,929 evaluation chunks; mark the 8,886 chunks used in the final aggregates. Retain counts, seeds, times and numerical verification fields; omit process and host identifiers.
Transcribe the nine resource-count rows of Table 4.
